śabdasya prabhavapradeśe patantī dṛṣṭiryogadṛṣṭiryasya tathāvidhaḥ san vanitāṃ
striyam

sā vāmā matpārśve akaṭhinaṃ mṛdu yathā syāttathā madhureṇa svareṇa evaṃ
vakṣyamāṇarūpāmāryāṃ papāṭha

he mune ahaṃ asatāṃ khalānāmucitai
rāgadveṣakāmalobhamohādidoṣaiḥ riktā virahitā cetanā ceto yasya tathāvidham

tathā
saṃsṛtilakṣaṇāyāṃ sariti pramuhyamāṇānāmavalambanabhūtaṃ taṭaviṭapinaṃ
tīravṛkṣabhūtaṃ bhavantameva abhito naumi praśaṃsāmi nānyamityarthaḥ
anādṛtyeti padaṃ vihartumiti padaṃ ca vyācaṣṭe - tata

śūnyarūpatvādeva tāni jaganti kānicit kvacidapi paramārthataḥ kiṃcidapi na paśyanti na
śṛṇvanti

ata eva kalpeṣu mahākalpeṣu mahājanmasu sargeṣu ca samatā aikarūpyameva
yeṣāṃ tāni

bahuvrīhau gostriyorupasarjanasya iti ṭāpo hrasve napuṃsakasya jhalacaḥ iti
numi punardīrghaḥ

parasparotpattisamārambhāniva parasparapralayasamārambhānapi tāni
na paśyantītyetadapi pralayasaṃrambhavarṇanapuraḥsaraṃ darśayitumārabhate -
athetyādinā

pañcameti itaḥ pañcamo
viṃśaḥ śloko jñeyaḥ

kalpāgnīnāṃ yāni jvalanāni teṣāṃ ye ullāsāstaistatprayuktavaṃśādigranthivisphoṭanaiḥ
paṭhanto vyaktamuccarantaḥ paṭapaṭāravā yeṣu

evaṃ jagatāṃ prāsaṅgikīṃ parasparaṃ śūnyarūpatāmupapādya prastutamevāha -
tatretyādinā

tatra tasminvarṇitabahuprakāre jagati kvaciccidvastuni ūhairvitarkaireva kṣaya udayaśca
dṛṣṭa ityanuṣajyate
astu ūhaireva kṣayodayaḥ kiṃ tatastatrāha - citīti

tataḥ prāguktaṃ
pāṣāṇākhyāyikāhṛdayaṃ citi sarvamityādirūpaṃ mayā anvayavyatirekābhyāṃn
parīkṣya dṛṣṭamityarthaḥ
kīdṛśena ūhena citi kīdṛśa udayaḥ kīdṛśo vā kṣayastānudāharati - tvamiti

he
rāma tvaṃ ghaṭaḥ paṭaḥ kuḍyamiti vā yadeva kiṃciditi rūpaṃ saṃkalpya nāmnā vakṣi
tatra tasyāṃ daśāyāṃ cit tvadvivakṣitaṃ tattatkiṃcittadvat tattannāmarūpātmaneva
bhavati sa udayaḥ

saiva vyomno'pi śūnyatamāvivakṣitā satī na kiṃcana nāma bhavati na
kiṃcana rūpamiti sa tatkṣaya ityarthaḥ
kiṃ ca jagaditi nāmarūpakalpanayā tacchūnyātmakamākāśameva bhāti

tenaiva tattvamasi ahaṃ
brahmāsmi neha nānāsti kiṃcana ityādiśabdātmanā pariṇatena nabhasā sarvaṃ
jagatparamaṃ cinnabha eva bhavati

he aṅga
pariśiṣṭaṃ yaccidvyoma tat kaṃ sukhameva
niratiśayānandaikarasamevetyanubhūtavānityarthaḥ

buddhiścaramasākṣātkāravṛttistadrūpo ya ākāśastatrāvirbhāvāttadekarūpeṇa
vyāpinā pūrṇenā'nantena trividhaparicchedarahitena mayā tatra tasminsamādhau
nasaṃkalpaṃ

atra anantena nasaṅkalpaḥ iti padaviśleṣaṣṭīkākāraiḥ kṛtaḥ sa ca
sudhībhirvimarśanīyaḥ

jagajjālaṃ brahmāṇḍasamūhāstadantargatā daśadiśastadantargataṃ
kalākāladeśādikaṃ ca sarvaṃ brahmavyomaiva tathā sthitaṃ dṛṣṭamityarthaḥ
tatra vakṣyamāṇabhedodayena bhāte saṃsāraśate ahamiva matsamānarūpā munīśvarāḥ

bodhena tattvadṛśā tu etatsarvaṃ brahma nabha eva
dṛṣṭamityarthaḥ

tathā ca brahmaṇaḥ saprapañcatā niṣprapañcatā ca dṛṣṭibhedenāviruddhetyāha -
nedamiti
padyate jñānena prāpyata iti padaṃ tadātmakam
acetyaṃn cetyaṃn vināpi citaḥ svasattaiva cetyajagattayā vibhāti

bhāmātrarūpakaṃ brahma
sarvaṃ karoti na karoti ca

yathā ālokaḥ prakāśanaṃ karoti
svātiriktaprakāśanāprasiddherna karoti ca tadvat

nanu yadi cideva jagattarhi candraḥ śīta eva sūrya uṣṇa eveti vyavasthitā
niyatirviparyasyeteti cediṣṭāpattiḥ brahmāṇḍabhede vaiparītyasyāpi darśanādityāha -
teṣvityādinā

cirābhyāsadṛḍhīkṛte bodhe yadvastu hitāhitasādhanatvena
yathā budhyate tathaiva bhojakādṛṣṭavaśādudeti

viṭapāḥ śākhāstadākārāṇāṃ
mūlaughānāṃ darśanādvajramaṇivaddṛḍhaiḥ śobhāvadbhiḥ patrapuṣpairābhāntīti
patrapuṣpābhaiḥ pādapairupalakṣitaṃ ghūrṇate ityarthaḥ
bhūtāni prāṇinaḥ paṭāniva meghānparidadhati paridhānaṃ kurvanti
pavanāśanāḥ sarvā eva bhūtāni prāṇino yatra
tatra dehabhedeṣvekībhūtātmabhāvanā kīdṛśī tāṃ darśayati - nakheti

yadvannakhakeśādike chidyamāne jāyamāne cātmanaḥ svacchedanajanmādi
paśyatītyanyatra saṃsthita iva bhavati

ata evāha śrutiḥ naha vai devānpāpaṃ gacchati
puṇyamevānu gacchati iti
tarhi kathaṃ sarvatra sarvātmakaṃ tadityuktaṃ tatrāha - yatnata iti

citpṛthakkārabuddhau tu dāruyantramayāni
hastyaśvādirūpāṇyaśeṣāṇi bhūtaughānīva cetanatayā dṛṣṭāni
netraśabdena tadarthena netreṇa tajjanyasaṃvidā rūpādidarśanena ca varjitānyeva

iti iyaṃ jagatsthitiḥ ekacintayā
ekāgracittayogimanaḥkalpanayā mayoktetyarthaḥ
prāṇo ghrāṇendriyaṃ tajjanyagandhaṃ saṃvicca tābhyāṃ vihīnānītyādi pūrvavat
yaduktaṃ tatra bhūtajīvanānupapattiśaṅkāṃ dṛṣṭāntena pariharati - dhareti
